A second cow lying upright, tagged '32', sits at the top of the box under the '?' marker, so the target is ambiguous. Behaviour: lying upright at -30 s, flat on her side at 0 s and +30 s, and still on her side at +45 s with her head moved. She did not change position in the pen.

Needs a tag-colour, ear and number check against the roster. I saw no discharge or laboured breathing; flank condition could not be judged.
